00 / The panorama

One continuous city.

A single 13,000 × 7,200 px master environment. The scenery travels sideways on its own, whether or not you scroll.

4 ALIGNED ALPHA LAYERS · EXACT RECONSTRUCTION
01 / Rooftops

Above the skyline.

Sky, cloud banks, distant hills and the complete upper structures of six independent, ground-supported transmission towers.

SLOWEST PLANE → FASTEST PLANE
02 / Upper floors

Glass and crowns.

Stepped crowns, helipads, curtain walls, ribbon-window offices and residential balconies. The same buildings, continuing downward.

NO SCENE SWAP · NO CAMERA ZOOM
03 / Middle floors

The lake between.

Water, shorelines, peninsulas and distant hills sit behind the architecture, appearing through the gaps and disappearing behind towers.

ONE LAKE · MIDDLE DISTANCE
04 / Entrances

Podiums and lobbies.

Retail glazing, canopies, signage, steps and ground-supported tower footings. Architecture keeps its identity all the way down.

ROOFTOP → STREET CONTINUITY
05 / Street level

Actual streets.

Intersections, crosswalks, sidewalks, autonomous traffic, signals, railings, sakura and evergreen trees — the bottom of the same city, not another skyline.

ANIMATED ROAD · TWO INDEPENDENT MOTION SYSTEMS

Motion controls

1.00×

Layer visibility

Sideways motion is a requestAnimationFrame clock. Vertical motion reads only scrollY. Neither reads the other. Road traffic is a decorative overlay; road markings are locked to the city plane.
Artwork: one master + four pixel-aligned transparent layers.
Implementation: two independent position systems.
